title: Án lệ 64 — MVP diagnostic slice
_howToUse: M2A stops before scene JSX: generated assets are intentionally absent until the customer returns the three manual generations.
Meaning first. The authentic Án lệ PDF supplies facts and legal authority; anonymous reconstruction supplies only actions the record supports.
No icon, diagram, map, block, template, code-drawn, or layer quota applies. Do not add decorative lines, labels, arrows, grids, or narration-duplicating text.
PDF source metadata is editorial crop guidance for M2B, not a new asset-manifest or PDF-processing architecture.
Generated board files remain whole until V3 generate_board.py crop-file is used in M2B.
